provider: Perplexity Projects (formerly Spaces) — persistent file repository

free_tier.stated: 5 GB per Project, 10,000 files per Project, 100 MB per file — identical on every plan, including free. Projects themselves: 'There's no limit on how many Projects you can create.'

retention.stated: Session uploads (not Projects) are 40-50 MB/file and are deleted after 7 days — do not confuse the two

egress.terms: No egress concept — files are read by the model or viewed in-app, not served over a shareable URL.

interface_detail: Web UI only for consumer. No public Files API. Enterprise has File Connectors and an organization repository (being retired 2026-10-01).
tooling: None for storage. Unofficial browser automation only.
chaining: Unlimited Projects x 5 GB each. Projects are the multiplicative axis and the help centre states the cap is absent. Unlike NotebookLM, adding a Project costs nothing and there is no account-wide byte wall documented.
limits_note: per-object-cap 100 MB. Session uploads (not Projects) are 40-50 MB/file and are deleted after 7 days — do not confuse the two. Projects created before Aug 2026 may exceed 5 GB and then refuse new uploads.
reliability_note: Projects retain files 'until deleted', which is the good half. But there is no API, so a programmatic client cannot drive this without a browser-automation wrapper, and it fails the brief's programmatic-access filter as written. Also, the access path is Perplexity's own readers — 'Support isn't guaranteed for every file type, so a file Perplexity cannot parse is stored without being searchable or actionable', i.e. opaque blobs get stored but are unusable and un-exportable via any documented route.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
